title: A New Generation of Perspective API: Efficient Multilingual Character-level Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated via subpopulation shift accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset (male and female demographic identities) and zero-shot performance on the TweetEval dataset measuring hate speech classification targeted against women.

Evaluated via subpopulation shift accuracy on CivilComments-WILDS (Black and White identities) and synthetic template substitution calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN, and BNSP metrics using terms like 'asian', 'black', and 'white' across multiple languages.

Evaluated via subpopulation shift accuracy on CivilComments-WILDS (Christian, Muslim, and other religions) and synthetic template substitution calculating subgroup bias metrics using terms like 'buddhist', 'catholic', 'christian', 'muslim', 'protestant', and 'sikh'.

Evaluated via subpopulation shift accuracy on CivilComments-WILDS (LGBTQ identity) and synthetic template substitution calculating subgroup bias metrics using terms like 'bisexual', 'heterosexual', 'homosexual', 'lesbian', 'lgbt', and 'lgbtq'.
Evaluated via synthetic template substitution using identity terms like 'blind', 'deaf', and 'paralyzed' to calculate Subgroup AUC, BPSN, and BNSP bias metrics.
Evaluated via zero-shot classification of hate speech targeted against immigrants (TweetEval dataset) and synthetic template substitution calculating subgroup bias metrics for the term 'american'.
Evaluated via synthetic template substitution calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN, and BNSP bias metrics for the identity term 'young'.
